touches.text: Trouble Ticket: an error that needs a non-automated fixer (CC or Akien).
In the event a second trouble is observed while the first is open, a new ticket is NEVER issued, we just increment a counter on the ticket.

A trouble has a point of origin, and that is how we match them up. When raised with a condition, its emission source AND error message are checked against open tickets. If found, increment the counter; either way, pass the ticket back to the caller.
Trouble tickets (3.3.3) live here. Any device has a direct line to raise one, not over the bus (2.2.8.1.3).
Runs a proof as its own process and writes a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon).
Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.
validation_store: reads and writes seals. → Tester
